data: Which line represents the KIC-tree size?

The question asks which line represents the KIC-tree size. From the caption, we know that the figure shows index size for varying vertices and keywords. The two lines in the graph represent "Graph size" and "KIC-tree size." 

Looking at the graph, the cyan line is labeled "Graph size," and the purple line is labeled "KIC-tree size." Therefore, the purple line represents the KIC-tree size.
